rows.grounds: Gloss 'that'; form sā = f.nom.sg of tad.
Gloss 'how'; kathaṃ is an indeclinable interrogative adverb.
Gloss 'becomes-thus-says'; bhavati + iti + āha contracted as bhavatītyāha (3sg.pres.act of √bhū + indecl. iti + 3sg.perf.act of √ah).
Gloss 'by-guru-exceedingly-weighty'; guruṇā + atigarīyasā -> instr.sg.m. of the compound guru-atigarīyas.
Gloss 'by-knowable-facing-knowledge'; jñeyābhimukhabodhena instr.sg.m.; internal compounding structure AMBIGUOUS between tatpuruṣa and bahuvrīhi readings.
Gloss 'possessing-sudden-growth'; drākprarūḍhatvaśālinā instr.sg.m. of bahuvrīhi compound 'possessing sudden (drāk) growth (prarūḍhatva)'.
